hook.text: If every English letter were equally likely, entropy would be 4.7 bits per letter. The real value is much lower.

buildup.text: Letters like E and T appear far more often than Q and Z. This bias reduces English entropy.

discovery.text: Shannon estimated English entropy between 1.0 and 1.5 bits per letter using human guessing experiments.

twist.text: That means English is about 75% redundant. Most of what you read is predictable from context.

climax.text: This redundancy is why crosswords, autocomplete, and spell check all work remarkably well.

punchline.text: English is mostly predictable. About 1.3 bits per letter.

quiz.question: What is the approximate entropy of English per letter?
